description:
[Coaching catalogue] List the coaching-catalogue directories you can see (your merchant's own plus the platform-wide public ones). Start here to find a directory id, to pick a parent for a new one, or to walk the tree with `parent_tag`; `is_start_directory` marks the page the catalogue opens on. The custom Markdown page is not included — read it with get_catalogue_directory. Returns 25 at a time; page with `offset` while `pagination.has_more` is true.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

filter_text.description: Case-insensitive search on the directory id, name and description.

include_public.description: Include the platform-wide `public` directories shared across merchants.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

mojito_language_code.description: Filter by language: directories whose default language or one of whose language versions is this one. Omit for all languages.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

parent_tag.description: Return only the directories nested directly under this one (its `tags_sub`), in the parent's own order.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Omit to include every status you can see (deleted directories are never returned).

name: list_catalogue_directories
title: List coaching catalogue directories
